source_integrity.scope: Source integrity only; not a mathematical proof or Lean replay.

visual_review.method: Contact sheets for every page, followed by full-page inspection of the new results, tables, notation changes, and final page layouts.

mathematical_review: Three AI-assisted integration reviews; new compositions checked against their stated inputs; findings and resolutions in the editorial dossier.
limits: Compilation and source checks verify document integrity, not mathematical truth. New compositions and the renumbered manuscript interface await alignment with Lean.
